ModuleName: Course Outcomes vs. Module Outcomes and the Alignment Map

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: An outline of the module's topics covering course-level outcomes, module-level outcomes, how to distinguish between the two, the structure and purpose of an alignment map, linking outcomes across levels, identifying alignment gaps, and matching cognitive depth — serving as a navigation reference for learners and instructors.

Artifacts.Name: Understanding Course-Level Outcomes
Artifacts.Description: A reading that defines course-level outcomes, explains their role as overarching goals at the top of a course's instructional architecture, and describes their key characteristics, helping learners understand how to write and use broad course-end competency statements.

Artifacts.Name: Understanding Module-Level Student Learning Outcomes
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains what module-level student learning outcomes are, emphasizes their specificity and appropriately narrow scope compared to course-level outcomes, and helps learners understand how to craft outcomes that describe what students can do within a single module.

Artifacts.Name: Distinguishing Course Outcomes from Module Outcomes
Artifacts.Description: A reading that contrasts course outcomes and module outcomes by examining how they differ in scope, audience, and function within a course's architecture, helping learners accurately classify and write each type of learning statement.

Artifacts.Name: The Alignment Map: Structure and Purpose
Artifacts.Description: A reading that introduces the alignment map as a design and communication tool, explaining its grid structure and its purpose in making the relationships between course-level and module-level outcomes visible and intentional.

Artifacts.Name: Linking Module Outcomes to Course Outcomes
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains how and why module outcomes should be explicitly connected to course outcomes, describing the principles and process of building a coherent, progressive outcome system across a course.

Artifacts.Name: Identifying Gaps in Alignment
Artifacts.Description: A reading that teaches learners to use an alignment map diagnostically by interpreting blank cells, overcrowded columns, and uneven rows to identify where course design has coverage gaps or imbalances in outcome alignment.

Artifacts.Name: Matching Cognitive Depth Across Outcome Levels
Artifacts.Description: A reading that addresses cognitive depth alignment, explaining how to verify that the Bloom's-level demands of module outcomes actually match or scaffold toward the higher-order thinking promised by course-level outcomes.

Artifacts.Name: Matching Cognitive Depth Across Outcome Levels
Artifacts.Description: A duplicate of the preceding reading on matching cognitive depth across outcome levels, covering the same content about ensuring module-level cognitive demands rise to meet course-level outcome expectations.
